about: A person, any pose. l_ and r_ are the character's own left and right; if you cannot tell, just stay consistent.

help.neck: pit of the neck, between the collar bones
help.pelvis: bottom of the torso, between the legs
help.l_hip: hip joint, top of the thigh

options.airborne: true if the character is jumping, falling or held up (skips the balance check)
options.support: optional [[x, y], [x, y]]: the two ends of whatever holds the character up, if it is not the feet (a chair seat, a hand on a wall)
